title: Configure AdGuard Home
description: Configure the AdGuard Home DNS server

host.description: Host name of the AdGuard Home web interface and DNS-over-HTTPS endpoint, like 'adguard.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

admin_password.title: Admin password
admin_password.description: New password of the AdGuard Home user 'admin'; omitted or empty keeps the current one (generated on the first configuration). bcrypt uses the first 72 bytes only.

dns_bind_hosts.title: DNS listen addresses
dns_bind_hosts.description: IP addresses of this node where AdGuard Home serves DNS on port 53. '0.0.0.0' (the default) listens on all IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and must be the only entry. Omitted keeps the current list.
